name: How much should I budget for fixtures in a primary bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is a realistic fixture budget for faucets, shower trim, tub, toilet, and accessories in a primary bathroom?
mainEntity.text: What is a realistic fixture budget for faucets, shower trim, tub, toilet, and accessories in a primary bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixtures can take a larger share of the budget than many homeowners expect. In a primary bathroom, the tub, shower valve and trim, faucets, sink(s), toilet, mirrors, lighting, and accessories can add up quickly. The range depends on whether you choose standard mid-range products or luxury brands with custom finishes and specialty features. A smart strategy is to set allowances early so the design stays aligned with your total budget. That prevents the common problem of selecting finishes that are beautiful but too expensive once everything is totaled. Ask the contractor or designer which items have the biggest cost swings. Shower systems, tubs, and custom lighting often move the budget the most. If you want a luxury feel without overspending, put the money into the items you touch and use every day.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fixture budgets vary widely, but primary bathrooms often require a meaningful share of the total budget because showers, tubs, faucets, lighting, mirrors, and accessories add up quickly. Luxury brands, custom finishes, and specialty shower systems can increase the total significantly. The best approach is to set a fixture allowance before shopping.
